steps.reason: Stratified: 30% of the applicants are bad credit risks and the sample is small.
All categorical columns are text with few values and no missing values; one-hot keeps them usable by every model family without an invented order.

credit_amount and duration have many outliers, so the robust scaler is used. The model family is open and may include linear models; scaling costs trees nothing and puts linear models on comparable footing.
